title: Audit cooked map coverage
objective: Determine whether every environment listed in docs/environment_ledger.json is currently cooked into the active Linux packaged build, and identify any missing map assets or stale package risks.
instructions: Inspect the active packaged Linux artifacts, especially Standalone-Development/Linux/SpearSim/Content/Paks/SpearSim-Linux.pak and Saved/StagedBuilds/Linux/SpearSim/Content/Paks/SpearSim-Linux.pak.
Compare the pak contents against all runnable environments and map paths in docs/environment_ledger.json, not only the cafeteria maps.
Also check whether corresponding source .umap files exist under cpp/unreal_projects/SpearSim/Content when practical.
Do not modify product code, docs, Git state, or packaged assets.
expected_outputs: A concise table or structured list of each environment alias/map path with cooked status in archive pak and staged pak.
Clear yes/no answer to: are all ledger maps cooked right now?
Any commands or evidence files used for verification.
definition_of_done: All environments in docs/environment_ledger.json have been checked against active paks, and missing/stale entries are explicitly called out.
